Jess (CS): Heads-up — onboarding friction signal spiking across 6 trials this morning, seeing drop-off between step 2 -> 3. Can we automate a CRM tag + kick off a playbook when the friction_score > 0.65? :thinking_face:
Samir (Ops): Which metric exactly? Is this the new activation_friction from onboarding telemetry or the legacy bounce_rate?
Maria G: activation_friction (derived event) — it's the one. Signal is: fraction of sessions with repeated help clicks + >30s idle during setup. Link to dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/onboard-friction (internal)
Jess (CS): Yes — tag on Account: onboarding_friction=high and add a task for CSM if unresolved in 72h. Also increment a short-term renewal_risk flag if it remains unresolved for 7 days.
Ajay R (Eng): We can wire telemetry -> playbook-runner via webhook. Need payload schema & rate limits. I'll post a sample event payload here in a sec.
Samir (Ops): For CRM hygiene: prefer a write-only service account that upserts a custom boolean field `cs_onboarding_friction` and appends a note with the raw metric. Avoid overwriting manual risk flags.
playbook-bot: New playbook template created: `cs/onboarding/friction_escalation_v1` (id: pb_2026_04). Triggers: webhook.activation_friction > 0.65.
Ajay R (Eng): sample payload:
```
{
  "account_id": "acct_12345",
  "activation_friction": 0.72,
  "session_id": "sess_9876",
  "events": ["help_click","idle_35s","retry_step"]
}
```
Maria G: Proposed thresholds: 0.65 = low, 0.8 = critical. For 0.65-0.8 -> automated CSM task + in-app tips; >0.8 -> immediate high-touch handoff and escalate to enablement.
Jess (CS): Sounds good. Can we also tag the trial owner in the CRM comment and include the top 3 events so CSMs have quick context?
Ajay R (Eng): Yup. We'll include `top_events` and `raw_score`. Also will emit `sample_window` so we can de-duplicate frequent noise. Need confirmation on dedupe window — 24h? 6h?
Samir (Ops): Recommend 24h dedupe for CRM tag to avoid flip-flopping. Playbook can still generate daily reminders while unresolved.
Maria G: I'll update the product spec and add acceptance criteria: event emitted, webhook validated, CRM field upserted, playbook run verified with audit log. Doc: https://redwood.app/runbooks/onboard-friction (internal, will update)
Jess (CS): Action items: 1) Maria — update spec + thresholds (by EOD). 2) Ajay — spike webhook + sample payload and dev hook (this week). 3) Samir — confirm CRM service account permissions and dedupe logic. 4) Jess — prepare CS playbook steps + templates. I'll start a short playbook doc and ping enablement for content. :thumbsup:
Ajay R (Eng): Est. 2 dev days for spike + 3 days to fully integrate and test with CRM sandbox. I'll add a ticket and link it here.
